reneuro: A European Energy System Model

Source: R/reneuro-package.R
reneuro-package.Rd

An open, extensible model of the European energy system built on 'energyRt', with the data, assumptions and processing steps kept inspectable. The current stage reproduces the core of the open PyPSA-Eur model and the workflow around it: reading networks, translating them into 'energyRt' objects, sampling in space and time, solving, and comparing the result against the source model. Planned extensions cover alternative datasets, a review of the algorithms that turn raw data into model parameters, further sectors, and links to other models.
